criteria.requirement: Add pyparsing.decimal_input.localized_decimal returning a real ParserElement that emits Decimal directly. Explicit decimal_separator, optional group_separator, positive group_size and optional nonnegative max_fraction define exact syntax; do not query host locale, use float or infer locales. Support ASCII digits, optional sign, ungrouped integers or strict first-short/subsequent-fixed groups, optional fractional part, Unicode grouping separator and precision. Invalid grouping/fraction/scientific syntax fails with normal parse_all semantics. Preserve existing pyparsing.common numbers.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
